learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected About $200 against About $1300 and About $5000; locked it in.
observations.exploration: Five years showed interest $3199. End on slider gave eight years, $5232 interest and +$2032 versus five. Left to seven gave $4542 interest, +$1343. Home gave two years, $1274 interest and −$1925. Screenshot at two years showed monthly payment $886.41.
observations.reveal: Corrected About $1300. Compared five years $386.66 monthly/$3199 interest with seven years $292.17/$4542. Explained slower principal repayment leaves balance charged 0.5% monthly longer. Fixed illustrative 6%, level payments, no fees.
observations.visual: Actual 1257 × 936 dark screenshot inspected. Principal block stays $20000 while interest segment and monthly figure change; dashed five-year total retained. Full reveal legible.

prediction.reason: Concrete commitment tests underestimating cost of lower monthly payment.

interaction.reason: Duration contrasts visibly change total interest and payment.

payoff.reason: Explains tested five/seven totals through slower repayment and fixed monthly rate.

clarity.reason: Duration label, total comparison and monthly figure clear on tested desktop.
clarity.evidence: Actual two-year screenshot and five-year baseline.

transfer.reason: Reusable longer-balance principle and conditions, no concrete new application.
transfer.evidence: Fixed rate, level payments, no fees caveat.

accessibility.evidence: Home, End and Left worked; other access modes untested.

surprise.reason: Committed $200 estimate contradicted by $1343 extra interest.

visualExplanation.reason: Fixed principal and changing interest block carry total-cost contrast.
visualExplanation.evidence: Actual block and dashed baseline screenshot.

playfulness.reason: Duration slider permits reversible range comparison.
playfulness.evidence: Two, five, seven and eight years.

practicalValue.evidence: Monthly relief paired with added interest.

depth.reason: Payment, outstanding balance and duration linked.
depth.evidence: Slower repayment and more charged months.

complexity.reason: Links repayment duration to monthly affordability and cumulative interest.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Distinguish monthly flow from total cost and retained principal balance.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Low: one slider and labeled figures.
complexity.notationRepresentationBurden: moderate: monthly percentage and currency totals.

whyCool: Stretching five years to seven cuts the monthly bill while the interest block grows by $1343.
caveat: Fixed hypothetical rate and no fees; reveal describes five/seven comparison while stage can show another duration.
missingEvidence: Focus order, contrast, phone, zoom/reflow and motion untested.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
